macros.name: thepdfnumber
macros.doc: Macro \thepdfnumber takes a number as argument and expands to a minimal representation of that number.

macros.name: thepdfnumberNormZeroOne
macros.doc: There are various places in the PDF specification where the number is in the domain 0.0 upto 1.0. Macro thepdfnumberNormZeroOne automatically adjusts the number to fit into that range.
